name: HRP-4C Miim
dof_breakdown: ≈30 body joints plus 8 face joints and simple hands
summary: A 'cybernetic human' from Japan's national AIST lab, built with realistic average female body proportions and a motorized expressive face. Part of the long-running HRP research line, HRP-4C was demonstrated walking on catwalks and singing and dancing alongside human performers, exploring humanlike appearance and motion rather than heavy manipulation.
notable: Life-sized android with a realistic motorized face shown in fashion shows and concerts
